jobs.title: Director, Transformation Engineering
jobs.description:
Driven to be the Best

People. Performance. Purpose.

At Avis Budget Group, we’re driven to be the best vehicle rental company in the world, together. Our 25,000 employees raise the bar every day, bringing different perspectives, taking ownership, and leading with integrity. We’re defining the future of mobility with safe, sustainable solutions that move people, businesses, and communities forward.

The Director, Transformation Engineering plays a pivotal role within our Transformation organization, building solutions that directly impact ABG's operations, decision-makers, and business results. This is both a hands-on technical role and a leadership role. You will hold the vision for your team's work: defining what gets built, why it matters, and how it should be architected, while leading a group of engineers through both the technical and scoping sides of delivery.

You will drive end-to-end development for some of the company's most critical business operations, working closely with business stakeholders to scope projects, guide your team through rapid prototyping, and oversee the path from proof-of-concept to full production deployment. This position is based at our World Headquarters in Parsippany, NJ.

What You'll Do

Own the technical vision and roadmap for your team: determining what gets built, in what order, and why it matters to the business
Lead the scoping process: work with stakeholders to translate ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable project plans before development begins
Oversee the technical aspects of all builds across the team, ensuring solutions are architected soundly, delivered reliably, and held to a consistent engineering bar from prototype through production
Serve as the team's go-to expert on the technical platform, guiding best practices, unblocking engineers on complex platform issues, and staying current on new platform capabilities
Own governance and permissions across the platform, ensuring appropriate access controls, data security, and compliance with ABG's data classification standards
Oversee the ongoing maintenance of existing systems and tools, including troubleshooting and root-cause resolution

Perks You’ll Get

Access to Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability insurance
Eligible to elect other voluntary benefits including: Group Auto Insurance, Group Home Insurance, Pet Insurance, Legal Assistance, Identity Theft Protection, FSA, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and additional life insurance coverages
401(k) Retirement Plan with company matched contributions
Full training to learn the business and enhance professional skills
Employee discounts, including discounted prices on the purchase of Avis/Budget cars
Access to an Employee Assistance Program for services including counseling, financial and legal consultation, referrals for care service and more

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field
5+ years of full-stack software development experience
Experience leading or mentoring engineers, with ownership of technical direction for a team
3+ years of experience in a customer-facing or business-facing environment, with a proven ability to engage stakeholders and translate complex requirements into actionable plans
Experience architecting applications to collect, manage, and process large data sets efficiently, with a focus on performance and usability
Strong collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams
Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments with evolving priorities
Bonus: experience in consulting, forward-deployed, or hybrid engineering/business roles
Ability to travel to field locations 5-25% of the time

The annual starting salary for this position is between $160,000 – $200,000 annually. Factors that may affect starting pay within this range include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Who We Are

Here at Avis Budget Group, you will be joining a team of 25,000 driven people, performing with purpose. Together, we’re moving the future of transportation forward with our innovative, customer-focused solutions.

Our culture is performance driven, where we encourage and support each other to be at our best through leadership, training, tools, and rewards.

We are proud to make a positive difference to the lives of our colleagues, customers, and communities where we operate.

Avis Budget Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other category protected by applicable law.

This advertisement does not constitute a promise or guarantee of employment. This advertisement describes the general nature and level of this position only. Essential functions and responsibilities may change as business needs require. The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law. This position may be with any affiliate of Avis Budget Group.

The Director of Engineering is responsible for leading and managing an engineering team supporting projects involving utility-scale solar facilities, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and related generation tie lines and substations. This role oversees engineering design activities, coordination with third-party consultants and contractors, and the delivery of technical support throughout project development, procurement, construction, and commissioning.
The engineering group manages civil and electrical design scopes, conducts design reviews to enhance system performance and reduce costs, and develops standardized, repeatable design solutions for future projects. Lead a multidisciplinary team of civil and electrical engineers and technical specialists
Continuously improve engineering design management processes
Forecast staffing needs based on active projects and future pipeline, and assign resources to support development and construction activities
Identify long-term resource requirements and recruit project engineering personnel
Act as a senior technical authority supporting development, M&A, and construction efforts, and manage external subject-matter experts as required

Develop and implement efficient engineering workflows focused on standardization and repeatable designs
Provide technical coordination with Operations Engineering, Development, Compliance, and Asset Management teams at various project stages
Ensure regulatory and compliance requirements, including NERC standards, are incorporated into project designs
Lead technical coordination with lenders’ independent engineers during design and construction phases

Education

Bachelor’s degree in engineering required; electrical engineering preferred
Professional Engineering License

At least 10 years of experience in the energy industry
Minimum of 5 years of experience in utility-scale solar project engineering; BESS experience is a plus
Experience working in PJM and MISO markets is a plus
Background in civil and electrical design, medium-voltage collection systems, high-voltage substations, and SCADA for utility-scale solar projects
Experience supporting construction and commissioning activities
Experience preparing or reviewing construction cost estimates for similar projects

jobs.title: Director of Design and Engineering
jobs.description:
Director of Design & Engineering — Data Centers

Founder-Led Data Center Developer, Owner, Operator

Highlights:

20+ years of hyperscale and enterprise data center delivery
$6B+ active national development pipeline
3M+ square feet of data centers delivered
Newly created, first-of-its-kind executive design mandate
Reports directly to VP, Engineering

Introduction

Valor Front Executive Search & Leadership Consulting has been retained by our client, a founder-led, fully integrated builder, owner, and operator of mission-critical data centers, to identify a Director of Design & Engineering.

Since its founding in 2002, our client has delivered more than 3 million square feet of primary production and failover data centers, with roughly 85% of its historical customers drawn from the Global 2000. That track record now underpins a $6B+ active development pipeline spanning established Northeast and Mid-Atlantic markets as well as fast-growing new regions.

About the Role

Our client's engineering leadership has been carrying master planning and design oversight for a rapidly expanding, multi-market pipeline directly, and the business has outgrown that model. This newly created, executive-level role will own technical oversight and master planning across the national portfolio, freeing engineering leadership to focus on strategy, customer relationships, and new-market growth.

This is a newly created role, not a backfill: the person who steps into it will define how the company designs and master-plans campuses across every active and future market, working across a pipeline that spans entitlement-stage new markets to fully-leased, in-construction campuses. The role reports directly to the VP of Engineering.

What You Will Do

Own the end-to-end engineering and design vision for the data center portfolio, including new-market greenfield builds and expansions of existing campuses
Lead master planning for active and future campuses, ensuring designs align with company quality, resiliency, and efficiency standards
Manage relationships with external design firms, MEP engineers, and AE consultants, setting specifications, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring quality and consistency across third-party design work
Develop and enforce engineering specifications, standards, and design guidelines consistent with a build-to-suit, substance-over-form philosophy
Serve as a primary technical authority on data center design, including electrical, mechanical, structural, and civil, with a mindset focused on both quality and delivery speed
Partner closely with Engineering, Construction, and Development leadership to align design with development timelines, construction schedules, and business objectives
Evaluate vendor and equipment partnerships for critical capital equipment, accounting for long lead-time procurement cycles and their impact on design decisions
Develop new market-specific designs as the company expands into additional regions
Provide technical due diligence support for site evaluations, new-market entry, and power/land partnership decisions

What You Bring

10+ years of progressive experience in data center engineering, design, or critical infrastructure, with direct involvement in hyperscale or enterprise data center design and delivery
Demonstrated technical depth across MEP systems, power distribution, cooling architectures, and structural/civil design for mission-critical environments
Proven ability to manage external design firms and engineering consultants, setting specifications, directing deliverables, and enforcing quality standards across concurrent projects
Experience developing repeatable, standardized design frameworks or base building specifications that scale across multiple sites and markets
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline; Master's degree or PE license preferred
Preferred: experience designing for both greenfield new construction and retrofit/expansion of existing mission-critical facilities, familiarity with high-density, AI-driven infrastructure requirements, experience building standards and processes in a growth-stage or founder-led environment, and comfort operating as a senior technical authority rather than in a hands-on design-drafting role

Why This Opportunity

Our client is in a major growth cycle, with a $6B+ active pipeline across established and brand-new markets, and design/engineering bandwidth has become a real constraint on how fast the company can move. This is a newly created role reporting directly into engineering leadership, with an explicit mandate to build repeatable design standards rather than maintain an existing process.

The culture favors technically credible leaders who are comfortable with ambiguity, and gives them real latitude to define how the company designs and master-plans its campuses going forward, with a clear path toward broader engineering or design leadership across the platform.

Compensation and Benefits

Competitive executive compensation, performance incentives, and a comprehensive benefits package (details shared during the process).

Location:
Flexible, based near the Northeast/Mid-Atlantic corridor preferred

Travel:
Regular travel to active project markets nationally

Call to Action

This confidential search is being conducted exclusively by Valor Front Executive Search & Leadership Consulting. If you are a senior data center design and engineering leader ready to build a first-of-its-kind executive function from the ground up, we encourage you to apply today with 100% confidentiality.

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

WebRezPro, part of the Fullsteam organization, is a market-leading cloud-based property management system serving thousands of hotels, resorts, and hospitality businesses worldwide, with continued growth expected through product expansion. The platform has built a strong engineering foundation for innovation. As the product portfolio and team scale, there is an opportunity to strengthen engineering leadership, standardize development practices, modernize the platform, and accelerate innovation through strategic adoption of AI.

The Director of Engineering
is a senior technology leader responsible for engineering execution, operational excellence, and organizational capability at WebRezPro. This role provides technical leadership to improve delivery predictability, strengthen platform reliability, and advance modern engineering practices, including AI-enabled development.

The Director leads a team of engineers and software analysts, delivering high-quality, predictable outcomes while building scalable engineering practices that support growth, product innovation, operational efficiency, and long-term platform modernization.

This leader will partner closely with product and business leaders to strategically leverage AI and automation to: Increase engineering productivity, accelerate delivery of high-quality product capabilities, and deliver differentiated features that support customer acquisition, expansion, and retention. Ultimately, this role ensures the technology organization can scale effectively while supporting long-term product innovation, operational efficiency, and revenue growth across WebRezPro.

Primary Responsibilities:

Engineering Execution & Delivery

Lead end-to-end engineering execution across WebRezPro.
Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery aligned with product roadmaps and business priorities.
Partner closely with Product, Design, and QA to drive speed, quality, and measurable customer impact.
Align engineering initiatives with growth objectives, including new customer acquisition, expansion revenue, payments attachment, and customer retention.
Accelerate development through the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices, including code generation, testing automation, and release optimization.

Engineering Excellence, Platform Reliability & AI-Enabled Productivity

Establish and uphold standards for code quality, system performance, scalability, and security.
Implement best practices for automated testing, observability, incident response, and operational readiness.
Drive platform modernization and technical debt reduction across the portfolio.
Deploy AI-enabled tools and workflows to increase developer productivity and reduce development cycle time.
Foster a culture of craftsmanship, ownership, and continuous improvement supported by data and automation.

Operating Model & Process Leadership

Own and evolve Pod & Sprint operating frameworks to optimize collaboration, planning, and delivery cadence.
Standardize engineering practices across multiple business units.
Continuously evaluate team structure, capacity, and workflows to improve efficiency and throughput.
Use data and AI-driven insights to improve estimation accuracy, capacity planning, and delivery predictability.

Talent & Organization Leadership

Directly manage engineer and software analyst team and develop them as strong people and delivery leaders.
Build and scale high-performing engineering teams across WebRezPro.
Drive recruiting, onboarding, retention, and performance management.
Establish training and expectations around effective use of AI tools to elevate individual and team productivity.
Evolve the organization to support scale while increasing autonomy, accountability, and outcome ownership.

Cross-Business & Strategic Leadership

Serve as a technical thought partner to Product and Business Unit leaders across Fullsteam Hospitality.
Identify opportunities for shared platforms, infrastructure, data models, and common services across Fullsteam Hospitality.
Partner with Product and GTM leaders to prioritize AI-enabled product capabilities that:
Improve customer workflows and outcomes
Differentiate the platform competitively
Create monetizable features or premium tiers
Support pipeline generation, expansion opportunities, and customer acquisition

to join our Contract Business Unit for one (or more) strategic global customers.

across all Orange services and solutions—post-sales and for organic growth pre-sales. You will lead the Architecture & Technology Office
, set the technical strategy and roadmap, and ensure that every solution we design is implementable, operable, secure, and financially optimized
.

You will act as the trusted technology advisor
for the customer, working closely with CxO-level stakeholders, the Contract Business Unit Head, Solution Leads, and our internal and external partners to translate business strategy into a robust, scalable, and innovative architecture.

If you are passionate about complex enterprise architectures, leading high-performing technical teams, and driving innovation and automation in a global, multicultural environment, we encourage you to apply.

Be the trusted technology advisor and global lead architect for a major customer account.
Own the end-to-end technical architecture of all Orange-delivered services across the full lifecycle of the contract.
Lead the Architecture & Technology Office, providing direction, coaching, and coordination for architecture and design resources.
Govern and sign off all new technical solutions and major changes, ensuring they are implementable, operable, secure, and aligned with standards.
Shape and maintain the technical roadmap jointly with the customer, aligned with their business strategy and Orange Business objectives (revenue, margin, satisfaction).
Support organic growth by managing a structured pre-sales governance for incremental opportunities within the existing contract.
Ensure architecture coherence and design consistency across all domains (data, security, voice, collaboration, cloud, data center, applications, etc.).
Drive innovation, automation, and AI-based services, testing them in lab environments and co-creating with the customer.
Ensure effective knowledge management and documentation, including design repositories and architecture standards.
Contribute to the CBU P&L, financially optimizing solutions and ensuring delivery according to or better than the business case.

What You Will Do

Customer leadership & architecture governance
Act as the global lead architect for the account, representing Orange in the joint technology board and other senior technical forums.
Regularly meet with customer executives and technical leaders (on-site, remote, and at industry events) to understand their business, IT strategy, and transformation priorities.
Design and maintain a detailed customer journey and enterprise architecture that connects business capabilities, processes, and technology building blocks.
Identify and document customer use cases and related service profile structures to guide solution design and industrialization.
Own the governance process on technology and service architecture, including architecture review boards, innovation boards, and change advisory governance.
Serve as the client technical advocate, ensuring that Orange solutions meet or exceed agreed expectations while preserving Orange’s business objectives.
Solution design, lifecycle & operations
Lead and validate high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD) across network, security, collaboration, cloud, and associated ecosystems.
Ensure that all solutions are implementable and operable by Orange operations teams, including clear operational models and handover criteria.
Support Order-to-Bill and onboarding processes with the right architecture and design inputs.
Oversee design documentation, including architecture repositories, templates, naming conventions, and configuration baselines, ensuring history is traceable (“why things were done that way”).
Guarantee technical design consistency over the lifecycle of the contract and across all projects and changes.
Manage and validate complex technical changes, ensuring impact on architecture, security, and operations is fully assessed and controlled.
Perform and coordinate handover to operations at the end of pilots and transition phases.
Organize and lead regular technical audits, contributing to the continuous service/solution improvement plan.
Technical leadership & ecosystem management
Lead the Architecture & Technology Office, organizing and prioritizing the work of architects, designers, and subject-matter experts assigned to the customer.
Liaise closely with Project Managers, Account / CBU Directors, Operations Managers, and other Orange teams to ensure alignment and smooth delivery.
Coordinate with hardware and software vendors, Orange Engineering, Product Management, and partner organizations to integrate best-of-breed technologies.
Provide technical escalation leadership during major incidents and crises, supporting root-cause analysis, remediation, and stakeholder communication.
Host regular technical cadence calls with the customer’s technical leaders and internal stakeholders.
Ensure information security governance across delivered services (compliance, security policies, risk management, and remediation plans).
Strategy, innovation, automation & AI
Jointly build a multi-year technology roadmap with the customer that addresses their future business needs and aligns with Orange’s portfolio evolution.
Proactively promote innovations (network, cloud, security, collaboration, digital services, automation, and AI) that deliver measurable business value.
Work with solution partners and digital / business consulting teams to define digital use cases, proofs-of-concept, and pilots, from customer journey to business case.
Test innovative solutions in lab or pilot environments, gather customer feedback, and guide industrialization when relevant.
Identify opportunities for automation, orchestration, and AI-based services to improve quality, agility, and cost efficiency.
Financials, reporting & stakeholder communication
Contribute to business case definition and validation, including cost modeling, risk assessment, and margin optimization for technical solutions.
Own the consulting and architecture effort estimation and sign-off, in line with consulting governance.
Present recent achievements, roadmaps, risks, and hot topics during Monthly or Quarterly Business Reviews (MBR/QBR) with the customer and internal leadership.
Support the account strategy by identifying growth opportunities, influencing deal shaping, and positioning Orange as vendor and partner of choice.

About You

Education & experience

University degree in Communications Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
10+ years of experience in customer-facing roles within the telecom or IT industry (service providers, systems integrators, or large enterprises).
Proven track record as a lead architect / technical director / solution lead for complex, multi-country or multi-domain solutions.
Significant experience managing and leading distributed, multicultural technical teams in a matrix organization.
Demonstrated experience in driving and positioning global technical strategies aligned with customer business needs.
Experience with large transformation programs (transition & transformation, modernization, cloud migration, SD-WAN, security, etc.).

Technical Skills

Deep understanding of carrier-grade networking and security, including technologies such as MPLS, SD-WAN, routing (e.g., BGP), and secure connectivity.
Strong knowledge of telecommunications / IT solutions and services, including hybrid WAN, cloud, data center, collaboration, and managed security services.
Experience in network/solution design and multivendor integration, including governance of standards and design rules.
Solid exposure to DevSecOps, automation, and observability concepts (e.g., infrastructure as code, CI/CD, APIs, AIOps) is highly valued.
Strong troubleshooting and deep-dive analysis skills to support incident resolution and performance optimization.
Good understanding of information security governance across complex, regulated environments.

Business & Leadership Skills

Excellent strategic thinking, able to connect business drivers with technology architectures and roadmaps.
Strong business and financial acumen, including familiarity with P&L management, business cases, and commercial trade-offs.
Proven leadership and matrix management capabilities, able to coordinate and inspire diverse technical teams.
Strong customer focus and relationship-building skills, with experience engaging at CxO and senior management levels.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills; able to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to handle complex, high-pressure situations (major incidents, escalations, tight deadlines) with composure and structure.
Experience working in international, multicultural environments and virtual teams.
Fluent in English (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus.

Nice To Have – Preferred Qualifications

Relevant industry certifications, for example:
Network / security: Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, etc.
Cloud / architecture: AWS, Azure, GCP, TOGAF, equivalent.
Project / service management: PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, Agile / Scrum.

Experience in digital transformation consulting, including customer journey design, business case development, and innovation management.
Prior experience in large-account Solution Lead or Enterprise Architect roles within an operator or global integrator.
Experience contributing to or leading internal improvement programs (industrialization, tooling, methodologies) in architecture or engineering.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.

What We Offer

Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

Only Your Skills Matter

Development of a high performing team of IT engineers, located around the world, with priority on enabling our engineers to design, develop, and manufacture world class technology products and solutions.

Travel domestically and internationally up to 30% of the time to support IT infrastructure operations globally.

12+ years' experience with increasing responsibility in IT infrastructure with Operations, Data Centers, Virtualization, O365, Networks, Support, and Security.
IT leadership in a globally diverse organization.
Experience in high tech, engineering and/or manufacturing organizations.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or other relevant fields.

Reporting directly to the CTO, this is a senior technology leadership role with real engineering substance at its core. The immediate focus is GNSS receiver design and GPS/GNSS navigation in harsh and GNSS-denied environments,
this is where where you'll make an impact from day one. You'll be working at the application level: signal processing, navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, Kalman filtering. The fundamentals that make navigation systems work in these environments.
Over time, the role broadens. Into sensor architecture and inertial navigation systems. Into APNT, alternatives to GPS, vision-based sensing, multi-technology integration and everything at the forefront of the field. You'll help shape where the business goes technically over the next decade or more.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage from a distance. The expectation is that you stay close to the engineering, hands-on, technically contributing, with a small specialist team around you.

Owning GNSS receiver design and GPS/GNSS navigation development as the day-one priority
Applying deep expertise in sensor fusion, Kalman filtering, and signal processing to live engineering challenges
Driving R&D across GNSS, INS, and IMU product lines
Contributing to APNT innovation, from alternatives to GPS, LiDAR, vision-based navigation, quantum sensing
Architecting and building hands-on across inertial navigation and positioning technologies
Mentoring and leading a small, highly specialised engineering team
Collaborating directly with the CTO to shape long-term technology strategy

What We're Looking For

You must bring:

Active, hands-on expertise in GNSS / GPS. A specialty in GNSS receiver design and navigation applications is a huge bonus
Strong fundamentals in sensor fusion, Kalman filtering, and signal processing
A track record of delivering commercial products in defence, aerospace, or adjacent navigation markets
The ability and desire to stay technically hands-on at a senior level

Inertial navigation systems experience: IMUs, MEMS, gyros, accelerometers
Exposure to APNT technologies, alternatives to GPS, LiDAR, vision-based or quantum navigation

You've probably held a principal, staff, or fellow-level engineering title, or a technology director role where you kept your hands dirty. You might speak at conferences, publish work, or be known in the inertial and navigation community. You got into this field because the problems are interesting and you stay at the forefront of the field.

Create and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap aligned with Anakeesta's growth and operational goals.  
Evaluate and recommend new technologies, vendors, and solutions to improve efficiency and guest experience.

Manage relationships with third-party vendors, MSPs, and technology partners.

Required

5+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 2 years in a management or director-level role.

Hands-on experience with POS systems in a retail, hospitality, or entertainment environment; experience with Gateway Ticketing and/or Agilysys (Eatec, InfoGenesis) strongly preferred.  
Proven experience managing on-premises server environments, including Windows Server, virtualization (VMware or Hyper-V), and backup/DR solutions.

Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance.  
Paid time off and holiday pay.  
Complimentary access to Anakeesta and other Revel Group properties for you and your family.  
A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture at a growing multi-property hospitality and entertainment company.  
Opportunity to build and shape IT strategy in a growing, guest-focused organization.

The Revel Group is a Knoxville-based management company behind some of the Southeast's most exciting hospitality and entertainment destinations, including Anakeesta — an award-winning mountaintop adventure park in Gatlinburg, Tennessee — and Wildside, among other developments. From breathtaking gondola rides and treetop skywalks to immersive dining and retail experiences, our brands are united by a commitment to creating extraordinary moments for every guest.

Founding CTO

PLANET.TECH — Austin, TX · On-site + in the field · Founding equity

About PLANET.TECH

PLANET.TECH finds problems where people aren't looking and builds technology to solve them, so that future generations inherit a cleaner, better planet.

Today the problem is cattle. Preventable livestock death costs American producers billions a year, and every existing tool catches illness only after it's visible, which is often too late. We built the first continuous, non-invasive biometric monitoring platform for cattle: a wearable that reads an animal's physiology around the clock and flags acute distress hours before a person could see it.

The hardware works. It's been on animals in Texas since spring. Our first 100-unit build is on the bench right now, and it goes onto ranches in September. We need the technical leader who takes it from there to ten thousand — and then decides, with us, what we solve next.

The question this posting exists to ask

Are you hungry enough to learn whatever you need to learn to make an ambitious vision physically true — and then build the team that does it again?

If that sentence made you feel found, keep reading. If it made you feel confused, this isn't your role, and that's okay.

The role

This is a builder's CTO seat, not a slideware one. You'll be in the lab, at the ranch, and across the table from investors — often in the same week.

In your first six months you will:

Own the path from working prototype to manufacturable product: design-for-manufacture, EVT/DVT/PVT, and a unit a contract manufacturer can build without you in the room
Own signal quality on a living, moving animal: sensor placement, noise rejection, and validation against veterinary gold standards
Drive cost-down from prototype economics to commercial unit economics
Lead and grow the technical team — embedded hardware, backend data, and biomedical data science are already in the building; you hire the rest
Stand as the technical authority of the company with investors, ranchers, veterinarians, and government partners
Set the architecture decisions — connectivity platform, firmware strategy, data pipeline — that we'll live with at 10,000 units

Who you are

You've shipped hardware at manufacturing scale: you've taken a product through EVT/DVT/PVT and into volume production, and you own outcomes, not tasks
Wearables, cellular connectivity, or camera/photonics module experience is a strong signal — that's the muscle memory this stage requires
You've crossed at least one domain boundary in your career and came out shipping. If a recruiter would call your resume "scattered," we'll probably call it coherent
You default to first principles when the field is new and to speed when the path is clear
You build teams, not just things: you've hired, led, and multiplied engineers
You hear "planetary-scale problems" and start asking what's actually hard about them
Austin, or willing to be. This company is built in person and in the field

What you get

Founding equity — co-founder-level ownership in a company built to last decades
A working product, live deployments, and paying customers in motion
A CEO whose job is enrollment, capital, and foresight — looking for the partner who makes the vision physically true
A real, measurable problem to solve now, in service of problems that matter for a century

How to apply

Send a resume, or a link to something you built, to careers@planet.tech with "CTO" in the subject line. Tell us about a time you walked into a field you knew nothing about and shipped anyway. We'll get back to you within 48 hours.

to join our Contract Business Unit for one (or more) strategic global customers.

In this role, you will be the overall owner of the customer technical architecture
across all Orange services and solutions—post-sales and for organic growth pre-sales. You will lead the Architecture & Technology Office
, set the technical strategy and roadmap, and ensure that every solution we design is implementable, operable, secure, and financially optimized
.

for the customer, working closely with CxO-level stakeholders, the Contract Business Unit Head, Solution Leads, and our internal and external partners to translate business strategy into a robust, scalable, and innovative architecture.

Be the trusted technology advisor and global lead architect for a major customer account.
Own the end-to-end technical architecture of all Orange-delivered services across the full lifecycle of the contract.
Lead the Architecture & Technology Office, providing direction, coaching, and coordination for architecture and design resources.
Govern and sign off all new technical solutions and major changes, ensuring they are implementable, operable, secure, and aligned with standards.
Shape and maintain the technical roadmap jointly with the customer, aligned with their business strategy and Orange Business objectives (revenue, margin, satisfaction).

Customer leadership & architecture governance

Perform and coordinate handover to operations at the end of pilots and transition phases.
Organize and lead regular technical audits, contributing to the continuous service/solution improvement plan.

Liaise closely with Project Managers, Account / CBU Directors, Operations Managers, and other Orange teams to ensure alignment and smooth delivery.
Coordinate with hardware and software vendors, Orange Engineering, Product Management, and partner organizations to integrate best-of-breed technologies.
Provide technical escalation leadership during major incidents and crises, supporting root-cause analysis, remediation, and stakeholder communication.
Host regular technical cadence calls with the customer’s technical leaders and internal stakeholders.
Ensure information security governance across delivered services (compliance, security policies, risk management, and remediation plans).
Strategy, innovation, automation & AI
Jointly build a multi-year technology roadmap with the customer that addresses their future business needs and aligns with Orange’s portfolio evolution.
Proactively promote innovations (network, cloud, security, collaboration, digital services, automation, and AI) that deliver measurable business value.
Work with solution partners and digital / business consulting teams to define digital use cases, proofs-of-concept, and pilots, from customer journey to business case.
Test innovative solutions in lab or pilot environments, gather customer feedback, and guide industrialization when relevant.
Identify opportunities for automation, orchestration, and AI-based services to improve quality, agility, and cost efficiency.

Contribute to business case definition and validation, including cost modeling, risk assessment, and margin optimization for technical solutions.
Own the consulting and architecture effort estimation and sign-off, in line with consulting governance.
Present recent achievements, roadmaps, risks, and hot topics during Monthly or Quarterly Business Reviews (MBR/QBR) with the customer and internal leadership.
Support the account strategy by identifying growth opportunities, influencing deal shaping, and positioning Orange as vendor and partner of choice.

About You

Education & experience

University degree in Communications Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
10+ years of experience in customer-facing roles within the telecom or IT industry (service providers, systems integrators, or large enterprises).
Proven track record as a lead architect / technical director / solution lead for complex, multi-country or multi-domain solutions.
Significant experience managing and leading distributed, multicultural technical teams in a matrix organization.
Demonstrated experience in driving and positioning global technical strategies aligned with customer business needs.
Experience with large transformation programs (transition & transformation, modernization, cloud migration, SD-WAN, security, etc.).

Technical Skills

Deep understanding of carrier-grade networking and security, including technologies such as MPLS, SD-WAN, routing (e.g., BGP), and secure connectivity.
Strong knowledge of telecommunications / IT solutions and services, including hybrid WAN, cloud, data center, collaboration, and managed security services.
Experience in network/solution design and multivendor integration, including governance of standards and design rules.
Solid exposure to DevSecOps, automation, and observability concepts (e.g., infrastructure as code, CI/CD, APIs, AIOps) is highly valued.
Strong troubleshooting and deep-dive analysis skills to support incident resolution and performance optimization.
Good understanding of information security governance across complex, regulated environments.

Business & Leadership Skills

Excellent strategic thinking, able to connect business drivers with technology architectures and roadmaps.
Strong business and financial acumen, including familiarity with P&L management, business cases, and commercial trade-offs.
Proven leadership and matrix management capabilities, able to coordinate and inspire diverse technical teams.
Strong customer focus and relationship-building skills, with experience engaging at CxO and senior management levels.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills; able to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to handle complex, high-pressure situations (major incidents, escalations, tight deadlines) with composure and structure.
Experience working in international, multicultural environments and virtual teams.
Fluent in English (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus.

Nice To Have – Preferred Qualifications

Relevant industry certifications, for example:
Network / security: Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, etc.
Cloud / architecture: AWS, Azure, GCP, TOGAF, equivalent.
Project / service management: PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, Agile / Scrum.

Experience in digital transformation consulting, including customer journey design, business case development, and innovation management.
Prior experience in large-account Solution Lead or Enterprise Architect roles within an operator or global integrator.
Experience contributing to or leading internal improvement programs (industrialization, tooling, methodologies) in architecture or engineering.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.

What We Offer

Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

Only Your Skills Matter

Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

new_jobs.description:
URBN is the parent of Urban Outfitters, Anthropologie, Free People, FP Movement, Nuuly, BHLDN and Terrain, operating across retail, wholesale and rental. We are rebuilding our planning technology leadership around a bold thesis: planning is becoming a product
, and the next generation of merchandise and inventory decisions will be made by AI-native, agentic systems
reasoning over our enterprise data — not by manually maintained spreadsheets and rigid legacy tools.

We are seeking an Executive Director to lead this transformation. You will own Planning & Allocation, ERP and PLM technology; carry our enterprise planning platform (o9) to completion; and stand up a product-oriented, agentic planning organization that becomes a durable competitive advantage across all brands and channels. This is a builder's mandate for a leader who thinks like a product executive, is fluent in modern AI, and can partner credibly with brand CEOs, merchants and finance.

Role Responsibilities

Scope of Ownership

Planning & Allocation technology — MFP, Key Item Planning, Assortment Planning, Demand Forecasting, and Allocation & Replenishment capabilities across NA, EU and Nuuly.
Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) — the systems and roadmap underpinning merchandise and inventory operations.
Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) — the technology supporting product creation-to-market flows and its integration with planning.
The o9 planning platform program — drive Assortment Planning to a successful, full rollout across all brands and channels, and own the commercial and delivery relationship with the vendor.
The agentic planning vision — define and build the AI-native forward path for allocation, replenishment and demand decisions, with an internal product team and clear human-in-the-loop governance.
Potential future expansion: Warehouse Management (WM) may be brought into this portfolio over time; the ideal candidate can grow into supply-chain-adjacent scope

Key Responsibilities

Set the multi-year strategy and roadmap for Planning & Allocation, ERP and PLM technology, aligned to brand, merchandising and financial goals.
Deliver the o9 planning platform to full production across all brands and channels, and keep the live footprint stable.
Define and drive URBN's AI-native / agentic planning strategy for allocation, replenishment and demand.
Drive the inventory and financial outcomes of planning — partner with shared teams and brand leads on key metrics and delivery.
Build, lead and develop a high-performing product oriented planning technology team; set the operating model, talent bar and succession plan.
Lead relationships with strategic partners, holding them to commercial terms, measurable value and driving innovation.
Partner with brand merchandising, planning, Finance, Supply Chain and Data Science leaders across the company.
Lead change management so new AI driven capabilities change how planning, inventory and financial decisions actually get made.
Represent planning technology to executive leadership and keep URBN ahead of emerging AI and planning technology.

Role Qualifications

Product-First Approach: Owns the planning vision with a clear roadmap, targeted user outcomes, and measurable business impact—not just a queue of IT tickets.
AI-Native Instincts: Reaches first for agentic, data-driven solutions to fundamentally reinvent how planning decisions are made.
Pragmatic Build-vs-Buy Judgment: Evaluates vendor platforms rigorously, spending capital accountability, and knows when to pivot, halt, or renegotiate.
Deep Brand & Merchant Partnership: Builds trust across brand leaders and seamlessly translates complex business needs into actionable technology.
Bias for Speed & Action: Pushes past endless design cycles to deliver rapid, scalable success across all brands and channels.
Intellectually Honest & Team-Focused: Leads with evidence, recruits top talent, and fiercely protects team focus so critical priorities actually ship.
Outcome-Obsessed: Measures success through core retail metrics (inventory productivity, margin, forecast accuracy, turn, GMROI)—not velocity or story points.
12–15+ years in merchandise/supply-chain planning and/or planning technology leadership, with senior leadership experience in a multi-brand, multi-channel retail environment (retail + e-commerce + wholesale strongly preferred).
Demonstrated ownership of enterprise planning platforms — hands-on experience with a Tier-1 tool such as o9, Blue Yonder/JDA, SAP IBP, Anaplan or Kinaxis, including implementation and adoption.
Deep command of the planning capability set: MFP, OTB, assortment, demand forecasting, allocation and replenishment, and inventory health.
Strong financial acumen — able to connect planning technology to inventory productivity, margin and working-capital outcomes.
Proven people leadership — building, developing and retaining teams, including distributed and vendor resources.
Track record of vendor and commercial management — negotiating scope, controlling cost, and driving delivery accountability.
Strong AI/ML and data fluency; credible conversation partner on modern architecture (URBN's stack favors Python microservices, MongoDB and Node/Vue3), data pipelines, APIs and agentic tooling.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science or related field required; MBA preferred.
Executive presence and the ability to influence brand CEOs, merchants and finance leaders.

Benefits include medical, dental, vision, PTO, generous employee discounts, retirement savings and much more! For additional information visit www.urbn.com/work-with-us/benefits
